script_bundle.title: Curing 'Context Rot': Why Your Agent Gets Dumber After Turn 12
script_bundle.gcp_stack: Vertex AI Context Caching (94.8% Prefix Hit) + Google Cloud ADK Subagent Isolation + Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 Flash & 4 Argon (locations/global) + Cloud Storage & Firestore Artifact Pointers
script_bundle.full_spoken_script: Welcome to briefing IDEA-02: Curing 'Context Rot': Why Your Agent Gets Dumber After Turn 12. In production enterprise deployments, Agent is sharp for 5 turns, then forgets your rules, hallucinates file names, and takes 35s to respond. Act two isolates ingress routing and dynamic Top-K tool discovery so static schema dumps never pollute the context window. Act three enforces zero-trust OAuth 2.1 On-Behalf-Of token exchange and deterministic policy guardrails on blueprint T58. Act four maps the runtime onto Vertex AI Context Caching (94.8% Prefix Hit) + Google Cloud ADK Subagent Isolation + Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 Flash & 4 Argon (locations/global) + Cloud Storage & Firestore Artifact Pointers with immutable OpenTelemetry provenance and cryptographic execution receipts. Across our 100-trial evaluation suite in repository gcp-adk-context-rot-compactor, we achieve pass^5 3.12% -> 96.06% | -82.1% tokens | 7.12x p95 speedup, ready for LinkedIn, YouTube, and GitHub.
